business_problem: Create a local mock-safe case management workflow for failed UPI-like transaction disputes without connecting to real UPI, NPCI, RBI, bank, PSP, switch, settlement, or customer systems.
functional_requirements: Create a dispute case from a synthetic failed transaction.
Attach mock switch and mock ledger observations.
Record reviewer actions with audit event identifiers.
Expose local FastAPI endpoints for demonstration.
out_of_scope: Official NPCI or RBI compliance certification
